notes.title: Meet Girls!
notes.content:
[h2]Vasilisa[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/15bc6ebd7ba03c98409978eb3e13842324844402.png[/img]
Excellent, beautiful and just a good person - Vasilisa Lebedeva!
Vasilisa is a graduate of the Faculty of Philology. She is a diligent and responsible student, adored by everyone thanks to her charm and willingness to help. She still lives with her parents, whom she loves immeasurably. The only thing that overshadows her life is her approaching university graduation and, as a result, an "adult" life with which she does not know what to do.

[h2]Yana[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/c60da0e99a067a6c7a8aa11fd3d00a8208024940.png[/img]
She does not like to be bored and will not let you get bored too.
During the day she distributes kittens, at night she paints the carriages, then she sits in jail. From idleness and boredom, she makes a scandal, because as Maxim Gorky wrote: "in endless everyday life and grief is a holiday, and the fire is fun."

[h2]Vlada[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/bb382ed55e2b57df85f446e4fc1a9c9954fe076d.png[/img]
Vlada loves to photograph buildings, ride a bike and read books in the park. An architect by education, she now works as a design engineer, but dreams of building cities for people. Vlada does not impose her opinion on anyone but does not allow an opinion alien to her to be imposed on herself. She likes cats, coffee, autumn and you.

[h2]Polina[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/d37cffeef8899df94b513f2616b45d48afbee8e7.png[/img]
Polina is a police officer. She believes that honesty and integrity are the most important qualities in a person and that the supreme duty of every individual is to be a citizen of their state. Outside of work, Polina goes to graduate school and likes rock-climbing. She also practices martial arts on a regular basis, since a police officer should know how to stand up for themselves. Generally speaking, fighting as a lifestyle reflects her worldview.
Oh, and, needless to say, Polina adores dogs.

[h2]Julia aka Lu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/3e687eec051a08d84fcf69ff02f4e4f7bed19d46.png[/img]
Julia is a business lady. She has her own bar business, her own apartment, her own car, and she achieved all this herself. Most of all she loves to gossip, talk about relationships, good sex and high waves at sea. But what she doesn't like is to digging into herself - in the end, what you do is important, and not what you think. As a last resort, a bottle of wine and a best friend will always help put the brains in place.

[h2]Anna[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36937151/100a68a320273d3a7d4c7e80f03c9dd817b4fbdb.png[/img]
Anna has been married for a long time and has two children. She's nice, but a little untidy. For the past ten years, she has been busy raising children and taking care of the home. But now the children have gone to school and Anna is bored. The husband is constantly at work, caring, but in all honesty, rather reliable than interesting.
So often Anna comes up to the mirror in the morning, looks at herself, holding the obligatory glass of wine, and thinks - is this really all?
